calls.video_title: Great time for Indian Markets? (after Trump's loss) | Akshat Shrivastava
calls.thesis: QQQ corrected ~10% to its 200-day moving average and the drop already priced in the expected Republican loss; he expects QQQ to trade 640-750 over the next 3-6 months as split US power cuts volatility
calls.base_case: QQQ consolidates in the 640-750 range; swing-trade the range or write put options against it
calls.bull_case: Greater policy certainty lifts QQQ out of the range to the upside
calls.bear_case: Sentiment drives another 4-5% drop, or dearer debt issuance squeezes AI funding
calls.note: First Akshat call on NASDAQ 100 / QQQ (Rahul Jain's earlier SELL does not count for flip purposes - flips are per creator). Range 640-750 is a QQQ level in USD, not a Rs price, so price_at_call stays 'not stated'.

calls.video_title: Where to Invest and where NOT TO? - Indian stocks vs US stocks vs Gold vs FDs  - Rahul Jain
calls.thesis: +20% YTD bull run driven by ~20 of 100 stocks, PE ~33 vs mean/median ~24 is a premium risk, but ~45% Q1 2026 earnings growth means no deep correction expected while EPS holds
calls.base_case: Market holds with moderate earnings (18-26% guided) and no deep correction
calls.bull_case: US economy and AI jobs keep earnings strong
calls.bear_case: Further Fed hikes (4% to likely higher) compress earnings and valuations correct

calls.video_title: S Naren's 36 Years of Investing Wisdom in 45 Minutes | The Legend Speaks | Rahul Jain
calls.thesis: Contrarian trim: extreme valuations on US AI-connected stocks, long bull cycle, extremely positive sentiment - take money out and rotate into beaten-down assets
calls.base_case: Trim allocation into laggards like Japanese government bonds
calls.bull_case: AI earnings keep justifying premium valuations
calls.bear_case: An unknown trigger ends the AI bull run and costly stocks fall hard
